_note: Guide channels whose shorts are pulled from YouTube's public RSS feed (the latest 15 each), plus single videos added by hand. Instagram reels go in 'videos' with platform 'ig' and the reel code; they are never fetched, only embedded. Hand entries may fix their own place with place/lat/lon and carry a note, and 'until' hides them after that date. idLists are whole catalogues read off a channel page.
